accroche.texte: 10 Claude skill repos to know, from security audits to design taste and codebase maps

explication.texte: Small, composable engineering skills that work with any model, meant to be adapted rather than to own your process.
passages: These skills are designed to be small, easy to adapt, and composable. They work with any model.
My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding.

explication.texte: Turns your agent into a security auditor: isolated agents hunt, and a fresh verifier tries to disprove every finding.
passages: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor.
Candidate validation -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it.
A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor.

explication.texte: Makes the agent write only what the task needs, without cutting validation, error handling, security or accessibility.
passages: The rule was never "fewest tokens." It is: write only what the task needs, and never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility.
The best code is the code you never wrote.

explication.texte: Gives your agent design commands to polish, critique and audit a page, and flags AI slop before release.
passages: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder , review with critique and audit , and catch AI slop before it ships.
The design vocabulary for your coding agent.

explication.texte: Explains a technical idea as an interactive isometric figure of a machine, in SVG, WebGL and 3D.
passages: A Claude skill that explains an idea by building it as a real, working object.
Crafted, interactive isometric figures with many small precise parts, in SVG, WebGL and 3D.
Crafted, interactive isometric figures with many small precise parts, in SVG, WebGL and 3D.

explication.texte: Produces each diagram as a single HTML + SVG file and can pick up your site's colours and fonts.
passages: An agent skill that draws diagrams as one self-contained HTML + SVG file, in your brand.
pulls your palette and fonts so every diagram after this one matches your site
Make me an architecture diagram of my app: frontend, backend, database, Redis cache.

explication.texte: Maps a project into a knowledge graph you query instead of grepping; code is parsed locally, with no vector store.
passages: into a knowledge graph you can query instead of grepping through files.
Code maps for free, fully local.
No embeddings, no vector store: a real graph you traverse.
Type /graphify in your AI coding assistant and it maps your entire project

explication.texte: Offers fifty themes and checks pages in a real browser for the tells of machine-made design.
passages: Fifty themes. Each is a material
lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made
A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.

explication.texte: Hands the agent an art direction, real photos and a browser check, so it stops building the average landing page.
passages: It gives the agent an art direction, real pictures and a way to check its own work in a real browser.
instead of assembling the average landing page.
makes coding agents design websites and app screens instead of assembling the average landing page.

explication.texte: A full development method built on skills: spec first, then a plan, then subagents with review and TDD.
passages: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills
having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work
It emphasizes true red/green TDD
It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY.
